purpose: Define a conservative map-wide time model so countries, relationships, memberships, roles, observations, project interpretations and historical events can be filtered by date without inventing precision or backdating later meanings.
core_rule: Time is orthogonal to the D1-D11 Axis. Axis changes analytical regime; Time changes which state or evidence was valid/known at a selected date.

date_fields.valid_from: When the represented state/relation begins to be valid, if known.
date_fields.valid_to: When the represented state/relation ceases to be valid, if known.
date_fields.announced_on: Announcement date when distinct from legal/effective date.
date_fields.effective_on: Legal/operational effect date when distinct from announcement.
date_fields.last_verified: Most recent verification that a volatile state remains current.
date_fields.date_or_period: Fallback human-readable period for legacy records that cannot yet express exact validity intervals.

epistemic_time_rules: A source publication date is not automatically the start date of the phenomenon it describes.
An announcement date is not automatically an effective date.
A later interpretation may illuminate an earlier event but must not be rendered as if it existed at that earlier date unless first_attested supports it.
Unknown validity must remain unknown; the renderer may offer include/exclude/flag-unknown behavior but may not silently treat unknown as timeless.
Current institutional membership should use effective legal dates where possible, not the date the archive happened to ingest it.
Project field membership/status is versioned project canon and should use the date of the recovered formulation, not retroactive timeless membership.

filter_modes.current: Render current/ongoing states using latest verified data and current project-version rules.
filter_modes.as_of: Render states known or valid at one selected date.
filter_modes.period: Render events/relations intersecting a selected start/end interval.
filter_modes.changed_between: Compare two dates and show additions, removals and changed attributes/relations.
filter_modes.first_attestation: For project/theological concepts, show only meanings attested by the selected date.
filter_modes.history_overlay: Keep present geography visible while overlaying dated events/relations rather than pretending all historical boundaries are already reconstructed.

options.flag: Show separately with an explicit unknown-time marker.
options.exclude: Hide records that cannot be shown to be valid in the requested period.
options.include_context: Show as contextual records but visually distinguish them from date-valid records.

relation_state.active_test: valid_from <= selected_date <= valid_to, with open-ended bounds allowed only when explicitly null/ongoing rather than missing by accident.
relation_state.legacy_test: If only a legacy date/date_or_period exists, parse conservatively; if ambiguity remains, mark temporal confidence low/unknown rather than forcing an interval.
relation_state.event_test: An event is visible when its date/range intersects the selected period.
relation_state.observation_test: A measurement is not a persistent state by default; show its reference period/observed_at and freshness distance from the selected date.

change_encoding.added: Present at later date, not present at earlier date under the selected dataset/version.
change_encoding.removed: Present at earlier date, not present at later date.
change_encoding.changed: Same canonical identity but one or more time-sensitive fields/edges differ.
change_encoding.reinterpreted: Same earlier event/record receives a later project interpretation; preserve both dates.
change_encoding.uncertain: Apparent change may result from source/coverage differences rather than real-world change.

initial_ui.status_line: Always display selected time and the count/handling of unknown-date records when a historical filter is active.
initial_ui.progressive_disclosure: Do not put a dense historical timeline permanently across the map; open detailed timeline only when the user enters Time/Roots investigation.

first_implementation_scope: timeline event markers where an honest place exists
empirical network membership changes when effective dates are sourced
country observations with explicit reference years
relationship edges upgraded with valid_from/valid_to or explicit unknown temporal status
not_yet_claimed: precise validity dates for every legacy relationship
